name: Project Review Storage Shape Audit
description: Perform an exhaustive, evidence-backed audit of project-review API, UI, DuckDB, worker, lifecycle, index, temporary, and local payload storage shapes. Repository schemas, code, runtime behavior, retention, and live/project data remain unchanged; only designated physical-evidence stories may mutate isolated disposable fixtures.

userStories.title: Establish the durable audit framework
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want one resumable evidence structure for every later story.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve substantiated content already in `STORAGE_SHAPE_AUDIT_PLAN.md`, and mark inherited dispositions provisional when revised proof is missing.
Create sections for all eleven required outputs, the five coverage manifests, reconciliation summaries, commands, blockers, and owner questions.

Define stable row IDs and four distinct state fields: manifest `auditStatus` uses only `not-started`, `traced-to-api`, `traced-to-writer`, `traced-to-lifecycle`, `measured`, `classified`, `blocked`, or `out-of-scope`; `proofCheckState` uses `satisfied`, `pending`, `blocked`, or `not-applicable`; `recommendationActionability` uses `actionable`, `unresolved`, or `blocked`; `overallCertification` uses `PASS` or `INCOMPLETE`.
Define discovered = classified + out-of-scope + blocked reconciliation formulas and require missing evidence plus an owner question for every nonterminal manifest row.
Write durable results only to `STORAGE_SHAPE_AUDIT_PLAN.md`, apart from Ralph tracker metadata; do not change repository schemas, code, routes, projectors, retention, runtime behavior, or data.

Cite exact files, symbols, routes, tables, columns, indexes, SQL shapes, tests, commands, or approved snapshots; distinguish production use from tests, fixtures, plans, comments, generated files, and historical migrations.

Never inspect live DuckDB directly, and do not strengthen a move, derive, archive, or delete recommendation before API, writer, lifecycle, recovery, export, transfer, and retention evidence is traced.

userStories.title: Freeze route contracts and benchmark configuration
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want product semantics and reliability-critical settings fixed before inventory and comparison work.
acceptanceCriteria: Record mounted review routes and read contracts with exact ordering, filters, counts, pagination, cursors, freshness, stale or unavailable behavior, snapshots, exactness, and response budgets.

Record fixture scale, seed, model, provider, thinking level, prompts, content flags, DuckDB memory limit, runtime profile, metric definitions, and approved evidence tooling without overriding configured values.
Separate source import or seeding time, projection or rebuild time, and foreground route-read time, and record route registry or parity discrepancies.
Write durable results only to `STORAGE_SHAPE_AUDIT_PLAN.md`; do not change repository schemas, code, routes, projectors, retention, runtime behavior, or data.
Use only the manifest `auditStatus` values from US-001 and keep proof-check, actionability, and overall-certification fields separate.
Cite exact evidence, update relevant manifest counts, and record commands, skipped checks, blockers, and owner questions; never inspect live DuckDB directly.
Do not strengthen a move, derive, archive, or delete recommendation in this story.
